title.zh: 建屋发展（升级工程分区）（家居改进计划）（第 2 号）命令 2026
title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 2) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 2) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 3 April 2026.

heading.en: Declaration of precincts for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estates of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be precincts for the purposes of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Ang Mo Kio Street 11, Ang Mo Kio Avenue 4, Mayflower Rise and Mayflower Avenue, comprised in Lot number 13267P in Mukim 18 and on which Apartment Blocks 104A and 104B are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in Plan 1.
Plan 1
Ang Mo Kio street 11
2. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Ang Mo Kio Street 21 and Ang Mo Kio Street 11, comprised in Lot number 13248W in Mukim 18 and on which Apartment Blocks 253 and 253A are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in Plan 2.
Plan 2
ang mo kio street 21
3. All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Pasir Ris Street 51 and Pasir Ris Drive 1, comprised in Lot number 01187K in Mukim 29 and on which Apartment Blocks 544, 545, 546, 547, 548, 549 and 550 are erected, in Lot number 01223W in Mukim 29 and on which Apartment Blocks 551, 552, 553, 554, 555 and 556 are erected, in Lot number 01395A in Mukim 29 and on which Apartment Blocks 557, 558 and 559 are erected, and in Lot number 01337L in Mukim 29 and on which Apartment Blocks 560, 561 and 562 are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in Plan 3.
Plan 3
pasir ris street 51
4. All that part of the housing estate of the Board at Woodlands Ring Road comprised in Lot number 03277A in Mukim 13 and on which Apartment Blocks 659, 660, 661, 662, 663 and 664 are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in Plan 4.
Plan 4
